section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. All data for this comparison were collected at the Willow Lane Cohort.

Table 3. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 80 | 350 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Side effects | 75 | 350 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Side effects | 52 | 350 |

| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Side effects | 40 | 350 |
